units.locator: Article 51. Charter of the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”
units.text: 6. Amendments and additions to the Charter of the municipality that change the structure of local self-government bodies or the allocation of powers between them (except where the Charter is brought into conformity with federal laws, or the powers, term of office or procedure for electing the Head of Yekaterinburg are changed) enter into force after the expiry of the term of office of the City Duma that adopted the decision on those amendments and additions, unless otherwise provided for by Federal Law of 6 October 2003 No. 131-ФЗ ‘On the General Principles of the Organization of Local Self-Government in the Russian Federation’.
units.label: Point 6 Art. 51

units.locator: Article 51. Charter of the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”
units.text: 6-1. Amendments and additions to the Charter of the municipality are made by a municipal legal act — a decision of the City Duma signed by the Head of Yekaterinburg and the Chair of the City Duma.
units.label: Point 6-1 Art. 51

units.locator: Article 51. Charter of the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”
units.text: 6-2. Restating the Charter of the municipality in a new version by adopting a decision of the City Duma on amendments and additions to the Charter is not permitted.
units.label: Point 6-2 Art. 51

units.locator: Article 51. Charter of the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”
units.text: 7. The Charter of the municipality and amendments and additions to it are kept by the Head of Yekaterinburg.
units.label: Point 7 Art. 51

units.locator: Article 52. Legal acts of the City Duma
units.text: Article 52. Legal acts of the City Duma
units.label: Art. 52

units.locator: Article 52. Legal acts of the City Duma
units.text: 1. On matters assigned to its competence by federal laws, laws of Sverdlovsk Oblast and this Charter, the City Duma adopts decisions establishing rules binding within the municipality, a decision dismissing the Head of Yekaterinburg from office, and decisions on the organization of the City Duma’s activities and other matters assigned to its competence by federal laws, laws of Sverdlovsk Oblast and this Charter. Decisions are adopted at meetings of the City Duma by open voting, including roll-call voting, or by secret ballot.
units.label: Point 1 Art. 52

units.locator: Article 52. Legal acts of the City Duma
units.text: 2. The procedures for preparing, introducing, considering and adopting decisions of the City Duma and sending them for publication (promulgation) are determined by this Charter and decisions of the City Duma.
units.label: Point 2 Art. 52

units.locator: Article 52. Legal acts of the City Duma
units.text: 3. Decisions of the City Duma providing for the establishment, amendment or abolition of local taxes and levies or expenditure from the local budget may be submitted for the City Duma’s consideration only on the initiative of the Head of Yekaterinburg or with an opinion from the Head of Yekaterinburg.
units.label: Point 3 Art. 52

units.locator: Article 52. Legal acts of the City Duma
units.text: 4. Decisions of the City Duma establishing rules binding within the municipality and signed by the Chair of the City Duma are sent to the Head of Yekaterinburg no later than 2 days after their adoption for signature and promulgation within 10 days after their adoption.
units.label: Point 4 Art. 52

units.locator: Article 52. Legal acts of the City Duma
units.text: 5. The Head of Yekaterinburg has the right to reject a decision of the City Duma.
units.label: Point 5 Art. 52

units.locator: Article 52. Legal acts of the City Duma
units.text: In that case, the decision is returned to the City Duma within 10 days with a reasoned justification for its rejection or proposals for amendments and additions. If the Head of Yekaterinburg rejects a decision, it is reconsidered by the City Duma. If, upon reconsideration, the decision is approved in its previously adopted wording by a majority of at least two thirds of the established number of deputies of the City Duma, it must be signed by the Head of Yekaterinburg within seven days and promulgated.
units.label: Point 5 Art. 52 · “In that case, the decision is returned to the City Duma within…”

units.locator: Article 52. Legal acts of the City Duma
units.text: 6. The Head of Yekaterinburg may use an electronic signature to sign decisions of the City Duma according to the procedure determined by federal law.
units.label: Point 6 Art. 52

units.locator: Article 52. Legal acts of the City Duma
units.text: 7. Decisions of the City Duma establishing rules binding within the municipality are sent for publication within 5 days after signature by the Head of Yekaterinburg and enter into force upon expiry of 10 days from the date of their official publication in the ‘Bulletin of the Yekaterinburg City Duma’, unless federal or oblast legislation or the decisions themselves specify other dates for entry into force.
units.label: Point 7 Art. 52

units.locator: Article 52. Legal acts of the City Duma
units.text: Official publication of a decision of the City Duma establishing rules binding within the municipality is its first full-text publication in the ‘Bulletin of the Yekaterinburg City Duma’.
units.label: Point 7 Art. 52 · “Official publication of a decision of the City Duma…”

units.locator: Article 52. Legal acts of the City Duma
units.text: 8. Decisions of the City Duma on the organization of its activities and non-normative decisions of the City Duma are signed by the Chair of the City Duma within 5 days after adoption and enter into force on the day of signature, unless federal legislation, legislation of Sverdlovsk Oblast or the decisions themselves specify other dates for entry into force. In cases established by decisions of the City Duma, decisions on the organization of its activities and non-normative decisions of the City Duma are published in the ‘Bulletin of the Yekaterinburg City Duma’ or another printed publication designated by the City Duma.
units.label: Point 8 Art. 52

units.locator: Article 53. Legal acts of the Head of Yekaterinburg and the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg
units.text: Article 53. Legal acts of the Head of Yekaterinburg and the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg
units.label: Art. 53

units.locator: Article 53. Legal acts of the Head of Yekaterinburg and the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 1. The Head of Yekaterinburg issues resolutions and executive orders of the Head of Yekaterinburg on matters assigned to their competence by this Charter in accordance with Federal Law of 6 October 2003 No. 131-ФЗ ‘On the General Principles of the Organization of Local Self-Government in the Russian Federation’ and other federal laws.
units.label: Point 1 Art. 53

units.locator: Article 53. Legal acts of the Head of Yekaterinburg and the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 2. In exercising the powers of the head of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg, the Head of Yekaterinburg issues:
units.label: Point 2 Art. 53

units.locator: Article 53. Legal acts of the Head of Yekaterinburg and the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg
units.text: resolutions of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg — on matters of local significance and matters related to the exercise of specific state powers transferred to local self-government bodies by federal laws and laws of Sverdlovsk Oblast;
units.label: Point 2 Art. 53 · “resolutions of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg…”

units.locator: Article 53. Legal acts of the Head of Yekaterinburg and the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg
units.text: executive orders of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg — on the organization of the work of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg.
units.label: Point 2 Art. 53 · “executive orders of the Administration of the City of…”

units.locator: Article 53. Legal acts of the Head of Yekaterinburg and the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 3. Normative resolutions of the Head of Yekaterinburg and the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg are sent for official publication within five days after signature and enter into force upon expiry of 10 days after the day of their official publication in the ‘Yekaterinburg Bulletin’, unless the resolutions themselves specify other dates for entry into force.
units.label: Point 3 Art. 53

units.locator: Article 53. Legal acts of the Head of Yekaterinburg and the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 4. Non-normative resolutions and executive orders of the Head of Yekaterinburg and the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg enter into force after signature, unless the resolutions and executive orders themselves specify other dates for entry into force.
units.label: Point 4 Art. 53

units.locator: Article 53. Legal acts of the Head of Yekaterinburg and the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 5. The Head of Yekaterinburg may use an electronic signature to sign legal acts according to the procedure provided for by federal law.
units.label: Point 5 Art. 53

units.locator: Article 53. Legal acts of the Head of Yekaterinburg and the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg
units.text: Article 53-1. Repealed. — Decision of the Yekaterinburg City Duma of 25.05.2018 No. 11/81.
units.label: Point 5 Art. 53 · “Article 53-1. Repealed. — Decision of the Yekaterinburg City…”

units.locator: Chapter VIII. ECONOMIC BASIS OF LOCAL SELF-GOVERNMENT
units.text: Chapter VIII. ECONOMIC BASIS OF LOCAL SELF-GOVERNMENT
units.label: Chapter VIII. ECONOMIC BASIS OF LOCAL SELF-GOVERNMENT

units.locator: Chapter VIII. ECONOMIC BASIS OF LOCAL SELF-GOVERNMENT
units.text: OF THE MUNICIPALITY “CITY OF YEKATERINBURG”
units.label: Chapter VIII. ECONOMIC BASIS OF LOCAL SELF-GOVERNMENT · “OF THE MUNICIPALITY “CITY OF YEKATERINBURG””

units.locator: Article 54. Economic basis of local self-government of the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”
units.text: Article 54. Economic basis of local self-government of the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”
units.label: Art. 54

units.locator: Article 54. Economic basis of local self-government of the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”
units.text: 1. The economic basis of local self-government in the municipality consists of municipal budget funds, the municipality’s property rights and municipally owned property intended for resolving matters of local significance and supporting the activities of local self-government bodies and officials, municipal servants and employees of municipal enterprises and institutions; property intended for exercising specific state powers transferred to local self-government bodies in cases established by federal laws and laws of Sverdlovsk Oblast; and property necessary for resolving matters that local self-government bodies are entitled by federal laws to resolve and that are not classified as matters of local significance.
units.label: Point 1 Art. 54

units.locator: Article 54. Economic basis of local self-government of the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”
units.text: 2. Municipal ownership is recognized and protected by the state on an equal basis with other forms of ownership.
units.label: Point 2 Art. 54

units.locator: Article 55. Possession, use and disposal of municipal property
units.text: Article 55. Possession, use and disposal of municipal property
units.label: Art. 55

units.locator: Article 55. Possession, use and disposal of municipal property
units.text: 1. The Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg and, within its powers, the City Duma possess, use and dispose of municipally owned property on behalf of the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg” in accordance with federal legislation, this Charter and their normative legal acts.
units.label: Point 1 Art. 55

units.locator: Article 55. Possession, use and disposal of municipal property
units.text: 2. The Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg may exercise the powers of a member of business companies on behalf of the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg” in accordance with civil legislation, transfer municipally owned property for temporary or permanent use to individuals and legal entities, state authorities of the Russian Federation (state authorities of Sverdlovsk Oblast) and local self-government bodies of other municipalities, alienate such property and enter into other transactions in accordance with federal legislation.
units.label: Point 2 Art. 55

units.locator: Article 55. Possession, use and disposal of municipal property
units.text: 3. Revenue from the use and privatization of municipally owned property is paid into the municipal budget.
units.label: Point 3 Art. 55

units.locator: Article 55. Possession, use and disposal of municipal property
units.text: 4. The Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg maintains a register of municipal property according to the procedure established by the federal executive body authorized by the Government of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Point 4 Art. 55

units.locator: Article 56. Municipal enterprises and municipal institutions
units.text: Article 56. Municipal enterprises and municipal institutions
units.label: Art. 56

units.locator: Article 56. Municipal enterprises and municipal institutions
units.text: 1. The municipality creates (establishes), reorganizes and liquidates municipal enterprises and municipal institutions according to the established procedure.
units.label: Point 1 Art. 56

units.locator: Article 56. Municipal enterprises and municipal institutions
units.text: 2. The functions and powers of founder in relation to municipal enterprises and municipal institutions are exercised by the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg through its bodies.
units.label: Point 2 Art. 56

units.locator: Article 56. Municipal enterprises and municipal institutions
units.text: 3. The procedure for adopting decisions on the establishment, reorganization and liquidation of municipal enterprises is determined by the City Duma on the submission of the Head of Yekaterinburg.
units.label: Point 3 Art. 56

units.locator: Article 56. Municipal enterprises and municipal institutions
units.text: 4. The procedure for adopting decisions on the establishment, reorganization and liquidation of municipal institutions is determined by the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg.
units.label: Point 4 Art. 56

units.locator: Article 56. Municipal enterprises and municipal institutions
units.text: 5. Heads of municipal enterprises and municipal institutions exercise their powers in accordance with the labour legislation of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Point 5 Art. 56

units.locator: Article 56. Municipal enterprises and municipal institutions
units.text: 6. The Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg, on behalf of the municipality, bears subsidiary liability for the obligations of municipal treasury-funded institutions and ensures their performance according to the procedure established by federal law.
units.label: Point 6 Art. 56

units.locator: Article 57. Municipal budget
units.text: Article 57. Municipal budget
units.label: Art. 57

units.locator: Article 57. Municipal budget
units.text: 1. The municipality has its own budget intended to fulfil the municipality’s expenditure obligations.
units.label: Point 1 Art. 57

units.locator: Article 57. Municipal budget
units.text: 2. Repealed. — Decision of the Yekaterinburg City Duma of 24.05.2011 No. 37/42.
units.label: Point 2 Art. 57

units.locator: Article 57. Municipal budget
units.text: 3. The Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg ensures the preparation of, and prepares, the draft municipal budget (the draft municipal budget and medium-term financial plan), and ensures execution of the municipal budget and preparation of budget reporting.
units.label: Point 3 Art. 57

units.locator: Article 57. Municipal budget
units.text: 3-1. The financial body of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg directly prepares the draft municipal budget (the draft budget and medium-term financial plan), organizes execution of the municipal budget, establishes the procedure for preparing budget reporting and prepares budget reports, and maintains the municipal debt register.
units.label: Point 3-1 Art. 57

units.locator: Article 57. Municipal budget
units.text: 4. The City Duma approves the municipal budget by its decision.
units.label: Point 4 Art. 57

units.locator: Article 57. Municipal budget
units.text: 5. The procedure for preparing, considering, approving and executing the municipal budget is determined by the Regulations on the Budget System and Budget Process in the Municipality approved by the City Duma.
units.label: Point 5 Art. 57

units.locator: Article 57. Municipal budget
units.text: 6. The draft municipal budget, the decision approving the municipal budget, the annual report on its execution, and quarterly information on the progress of municipal budget execution and the numbers of municipal servants in local self-government bodies and employees of municipal institutions, indicating actual expenditure on their remuneration, are subject to official publication.
units.label: Point 6 Art. 57

units.locator: Article 58. Municipal budget revenue
units.text: Article 58. Municipal budget revenue
units.label: Art. 58

units.locator: Article 58. Municipal budget revenue
units.text: Municipal budget revenue is formed in accordance with the budget legislation of the Russian Federation, legislation on taxes and levies, and legislation on other compulsory payments.
units.label: Art. 58 · text

units.locator: Article 59. Municipal budget expenditure
units.text: Article 59. Municipal budget expenditure
units.label: Art. 59

units.locator: Article 59. Municipal budget expenditure
units.text: 1. Municipal budget expenditure is formed in accordance with the municipality’s expenditure obligations established and fulfilled by the municipality’s local self-government bodies in accordance with the requirements of the Budget Code of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Point 1 Art. 59

units.locator: Article 59. Municipal budget expenditure
units.text: 2. The municipality’s expenditure obligations are fulfilled from municipal budget funds in accordance with the requirements of the Budget Code of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Point 2 Art. 59

units.locator: Article 60. Procurement to meet municipal needs
units.text: Article 60. Procurement to meet municipal needs
units.label: Art. 60

units.locator: Article 60. Procurement to meet municipal needs
units.text: 1. Procurement of goods, works and services to meet municipal needs is carried out in accordance with the legislation of the Russian Federation on the contract system in the procurement of goods, works and services to meet state and municipal needs.
units.label: Point 1 Art. 60

units.locator: Article 60. Procurement to meet municipal needs
units.text: 2. Procurement of goods, works and services to meet municipal needs is funded from the municipal budget.
units.label: Point 2 Art. 60

units.locator: Article 61. Budget process
units.text: Article 61. Budget process
units.label: Art. 61

units.locator: Article 61. Budget process
units.text: 1. The budget process is the activity, regulated by the legislation of the Russian Federation, of state authorities, local self-government bodies and other participants in the budget process in preparing and considering the draft municipal budget, approving and executing the municipal budget, monitoring its execution, maintaining budget accounting, and preparing, externally verifying, considering and approving budget reporting.
units.label: Point 1 Art. 61

units.locator: Article 61. Budget process
units.text: 2. Participants in the budget process are:
units.label: Point 2 Art. 61

units.locator: Article 61. Budget process
units.text: the Head of Yekaterinburg;
units.label: Point 2 Art. 61 · “the Head of Yekaterinburg;”

units.locator: Article 61. Budget process
units.text: the City Duma;
units.label: Point 2 Art. 61 · “the City Duma;”

units.locator: Article 61. Budget process
units.text: the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg;
units.label: Point 2 Art. 61 · “the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg;”

units.locator: Article 61. Budget process
units.text: municipal financial control bodies;
units.label: Point 2 Art. 61 · “municipal financial control bodies;”
